name: installment_settlement_integrity
preconditionSql: SELECT to_regclass('public.installment_plans') IS NOT NULL AND to_regclass('public.installments') IS NOT NULL AND to_regclass('public.financial_allocations') IS NOT NULL AND to_regprocedure('public.fn_cheque_lifecycle_guard()') IS NOT NULL AS ok;
verificationSql: SELECT to_regprocedure('public.fn_installment_projected_status(numeric,numeric,date,date)') IS NOT NULL AND to_regprocedure('public.fn_installment_effective_paid(uuid)') IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgname='bt_installment_plans__guard' AND NOT tgisinternal) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgname='bt_installments__guard' AND NOT tgisinternal) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgname='bt_financial_allocations__installment_guard' AND NOT tgisinternal) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgname='at_financial_allocations__installment_refresh' AND NOT tgisinternal) AS ok;
recovery: Transactional failure restores the pre-09.07 state. After success use forward-only migrations; do not rewrite migration 0033.
